title: Conditional on RH: the Cesàro average of the number of Goldbach representations, after Goldston and Yang
abstract: Conditional on RH: a sorry-free Lean 4 proof of Theorem 2 of D. A. Goldston and L. Yang, The average number of Goldbach representations, arXiv 1601.06902, in Prime numbers and representation theory, Science Press 2017. With G(n) the sum over m1 + m2 = n of Lambda(m1) Lambda(m2), Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis, taken as an explicit hypothesis of the theorem and never as an axiom, implies that the sum over n <= N of 1 - n/N times G(n) equals N^2/6 - 2 times the sum over nontrivial zeros rho of N^{rho+1} divided by rho times rho+1 times rho+2, plus O(N), for N >= 2. The zero sum counts zeros with multiplicity, and its absolute convergence is proved unconditionally. Binary Goldbach is open and is not claimed; this is an average over n. An AI agent wrote the Lean code; the statements were checked against the paper by an AI agent and are offered for human audit.
